name: Cursed Ground bleeds the victims of a five-target Sanguine Rupture (#2041)
contract: Cursed Ground 561195 has two effects. Effect 0 (aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 10 = SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME, BasePoints 1999, EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 2147483648)) is native and already works. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (aura 42) on Cursed Ground 561205, whose own single effect is an aura 4 dummy with no handler and no spell_script_names row, so it carries nothing but the client tooltip. The bleed the tooltip names is Cursed Ground 561303 (aura 3 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE, BasePoints 86, RealPointsPerLevel 1.02, Amplitude 500, Mechanic 15, TargetA 6 = enemy). The condition - 'when you strike at least 5 enemies' in one cast - has no spell_proc column, so it is implemented in AscensionBloodmageTalents.cpp. Sanguine Rupture is cast as rank 572907, the rank a level-80 character owns per AscensionSpellProgressionData.h; its SpellFamilyFlags (0, 0, 2147483648) are the same class mask the talent's own native effect uses, and its two effects are TargetA 22 / TargetB 15 (destination area enemy) with radius index 14, so one cast strikes every dummy in range. Six dummies are spawned so the five-target threshold is crossed with one to spare. No proc chance is involved: the record's ProcChance is 100 and the condition is deterministic.
